correctness.rationale: An explicit two-way bijection identifies the maximum number of binary rich arches over all cyclic rotations with the matching number of unlike adjacent cyclic pairs. Parity-even transition vectors have two binary lifts. Non-full-transition cyclic runs contribute ceil(length/2) and admit a pointed logarithmic GF, while the all-transition even-length cycles have a separately counted correction. Coefficient extraction establishes every n>=1 and every k>=0, including constants and n=2; 262,142 brute-force word cases and the independent GF recurrence to n=256 have been executed successfully.
